title: Typed Dictionary causing max recursion reached error
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in all 4.4 betas, with this project. Current v4.4.beta4.official [93d270693]

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta4 - Nobara Linux 41 (KDE Plasma) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6750 XT (RADV NAVI22) - AMD Ryzen 5 7600 6-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

I'm working on a state machine that uses typed dictionaries in the form of Dictionary[State, String] for transitions. Everything was working fine until today it began to freeze whenever I try to add a new entry to the Dictionary. Tried reproducing it with a blank project and the error doesn't occur. I'm attaching the project here, there will be some error while loading because I've removed some assets, it can be ignored.

The error will also happen if the current key is removed and then added again.
The scripts are not marked as `@tool` and addons were removed.

### Steps to reproduce

How to reproduce:
- Open player.tscn
- Select "Grounded" State in StateMachine
- In "Transitions" click "Assign"
- Select a State such as Stagger
